items.title: Blazers Travel to North Texas for Regular Season Finale
items.summary: BIRMINGHAM, Ala. – With bowl eligibility already secured, the UAB football team looks to finish the 2026 regular season on a high note Saturday, Nov. 28, when the Blazers travel to Denton, Texas, to face North Texas in an American Conference matchup at DATCU Stadium. Kickoff is scheduled for 3 p.m. CT, with the game televised nationally on ESPNU.

items.title: UAB's Todd Grantham Named Broyles Award Nominee
items.summary: BIRMINGHAM, Ala. – UAB defensive coordinator Todd Grantham has been named a nominee for the 2026 Broyles Award, presented annually to the nation's top assistant coach, following a remarkable defensive turnaround in his first season with the Blazers.

items.title: UAB Set for Regular Season Finale at North Texas
items.summary: BIRMINGHAM, Ala. – The UAB football team will look to close the 2026 regular season on a high note Saturday, Nov. 28, when the Blazers travel to Denton, Texas, to face North Texas in an American Conference matchup at DATCU Stadium. Kickoff is scheduled for 3 p.m. CT on ESPNU.

items.title: UAB Falls to UTSA 19-17 in Senior Night Home Finale
items.summary: BIRMINGHAM, Ala. – UAB football rallied from an early 14-point deficit and had an opportunity to take the lead in the final minute, but a 57-yard field goal attempt fell short as UTSA escaped Protective Stadium with a 19-17 victory Saturday night.

items.title: UAB Hosts UTSA Saturday for Senior Night, Seeking Perfect Home Season
items.summary: BIRMINGHAM, Ala. – With bowl eligibility secured and an undefeated home record on the line, UAB football returns to Protective Stadium Saturday, Nov. 21, to host UTSA in a pivotal American Conference matchup on Senior Night. Kickoff is scheduled for 7 p.m. CT, with the game televised nationally on ESPNU.

items.title: GameDay Guide: UTSA, November 21
items.summary: The UAB football team returns to Protective Stadium for its regular-season home finale Saturday, Nov. 21, hosting UTSA in a pivotal American Conference matchup presented by Publix. Kickoff is scheduled for 7 p.m. CT on ESPNU.

items.title: Jonah Delange Named Lou Groza Award Semifinalist
items.summary: BIRMINGHAM, Ala. – UAB senior kicker Jonah Delange has been named one of 20 semifinalists for the 2026 Lou Groza Collegiate Place-Kicker Award presented by the Orange Bowl, the Palm Beach County Sports Commission announced Tuesday.

items.title: Blazers Turn Attention to UTSA for Senior Day at Protective Stadium
items.summary: BIRMINGHAM, Ala. – With bowl eligibility secured for the first time since 2022, the UAB football team returns to Protective Stadium on Saturday, Nov. 21, for a pivotal American Conference matchup against UTSA. Kickoff is scheduled for 7 p.m. CT on ESPNU.

items.title: UAB Football Season Finale at North Texas Set for 3 pm on ESPN U
items.summary: BIRMINGHAM, Ala. – The American Conference announced Monday that UAB football's regular-season finale at North Texas on Saturday, Nov. 28, will kick off at 3 p.m. CT and air nationally on ESPNU.

items.title: Dean Named American Defensive Player of the Week for Third Time; Robinson Earns Honorable Mention
items.summary: BIRMINGHAM, Ala. – For the third time this season, UAB defensive end Marlin Dean has been named the American Conference Defensive Player of the Week, the league announced Monday. Running back Rod Robinson II also earned honorable mention recognition following the Blazers' 36-10 victory at Temple on Saturday.
